shots.name: runaway
shots.title: Where an error starts
shots.caption: pdflatex only says the file ended. SaTeX shows line 5, where the brace of \textbf is never closed.

shots.name: clone
shots.title: Lint rules
shots.caption: Rules find what compiles but goes wrong: repeated blocks, wrong dashes, hand-written references. Each finding names its rule and how to fix it.

shots.name: page
shots.title: Page layout
shots.caption: Margins, paper and header to scale, as the run computed them. Apply writes geometry's options, or typearea's for KOMA-Script.

shots.name: color
shots.title: Colors
shots.caption: See every color your document defines, in every model xcolor knows.

shots.name: typeset
shots.title: Typeset view
shots.caption: Read what each paragraph sets, math included, without compiling.

shots.name: findings
shots.title: Findings
shots.caption: Every finding names its rule, tells you why it matters and cites its sources.

shots.name: explain
shots.title: Explanations
shots.caption: Find out where a command comes from, what it takes and what it expands to.

shots.name: units
shots.title: Lengths
shots.caption: Hover a length to see it in every unit and as a share of the text width.

shots.name: float
shots.title: Float placement
shots.caption: Toggle each placement letter and see what LaTeX does with it.

shots.name: glossary
shots.title: Glossary, index, bibliography
shots.caption: Browse the entries your document defines, with their fields and every use.

shots.name: forest
shots.title: Trees
shots.caption: Drag the branches of a forest tree into a new order. The bracket notation follows.

shots.name: theorem
shots.title: Theorems
shots.caption: See every theorem kind, its counter and each use. Rename a kind and SaTeX rewrites every environment.

shots.name: library
shots.title: Library
shots.caption: Search every macro your packages define, with its arguments and what it sets.

shots.name: settings
shots.title: Settings
shots.caption: Switch rules and plugins on or off. Each setting explains itself and shows its YAML.
